name: gizza-ai/job-posting-parser
summary: Extract title, company, salary, location, skills, and work mode from a pasted job ad.

tool.description: Parse a pasted job posting into deterministic structured fields: title, company, location, salary or compensation range, employment type, remote/hybrid/onsite work mode, experience level, skills, warnings, and optional evidence snippets. This is a pure Rust heuristic parser for triage and spreadsheet cleanup: it does not call an LLM, scrape websites, infer hidden facts, or normalize against a private taxonomy. Provide the full job posting text in posting; choose json or markdown output; keep include_evidence enabled when you want to audit why a field was selected.

include_evidence.description: Include short evidence lines showing which source text produced key fields (default true).

output.description: Output format. JSON is best for downstream scripts; Markdown is easier to paste into notes.

posting.description: Raw job posting text to parse. Paste the title/header, company line, location, compensation, requirements, and skills sections when available.
